name: Eggcellent Equations
author: Addicting Games
description: Eggcellant Equations is a math game mixed with an action game. There are eggs falling from the sky! No one knows why but this chicken is out to save the life within each egg. Help this chicken collect as many falling eggs before they fall and crash to the ground. Some eggs are falling slow and some eggs are falling fast. Some are big and easy to catch, while others are small and hard to catch. For every egg you let fall, you lose one life. When your game session ends, that’s when the math begins. To play another session, you must answer math questions correctly. There are several skills for you to practice like addition, subtraction, and counting. For upper-level students, there is also geometry, algebra, and percentages.
